queries:
SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.event_name;
SELECT event_name, AVG(event_avg_spent) AS avg_spent
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, AVG(b.spent) AS event_avg_spent
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
) AS per_event
GROUP BY event_name;
SELECT e.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member)
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id;
SELECT AVG(avg_amount)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(i.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM member m
    LEFT JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.first_name, m.last_name
);
